81:t_1:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

81:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Wow... so you've been fighting those 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 this whole time, Big Bro $$レド$$?」

81:t_1:5.en:
$$レド$$
「My time in service is only 145,000 hours, though.」

81:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Um... 145,000 hours... so since a day has 24 hours...」

81:t_1:7.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「That's about 16 years, give or take.」

81:t_1:8.en:
$$恵子$$
「So does that mean you've been in the military ever since you were born?」

81:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「...The greatest purpose of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is the annihilation of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

81:t_1:10.en:
$n
「In other words, the lives of the people who belong to it are the same thing as their activity as soldiers...」

81:t_1:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn, that's something. So you've literally been on the battlefield since the day you were born.」

81:t_1:12.en:
$$マオ$$
「Even $$宗介$$ must be surprised by that.」

81:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is exactly why you need to broaden your perspective.」

81:t_1:14.en:
$$レド$$
「That is why I decided to travel with you.」

81:t_1:15.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What a shame... If times were more peaceful, $$レド$$ could go to school and do Volunteer Club activities with us.」

81:t_1:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「Volunteer Club? What the heck is that?」

81:t_1:17.en:
$n
「For the world, for others... and for school credit. It's a team that contributes to society with good will and a spirit of service.」

81:t_1:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Mostly we just pick up trash, though.」

81:t_1:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's so lame. I'm not gonna do something like that.」

81:t_1:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's what he says, Vice President.」

81:t_1:21.en:
$n
「Fine, $$勝平$$. I'll teach you how fun picking up trash is.」

81:t_1:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「N-No thanks...! Your face is scary, Big Bro $n!」

81:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But doing something for other people is admirable. Right, $$レド$$?」

81:t_1:24.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't really understand. All I've ever done is fight.」

81:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「True, a spirit of service is hard to explain. It's not exactly about staying alive, either...」

81:t_1:26.en:
$n
「That's precisely why I think it's a uniquely human act. In other words, a spirit of service and good will are the very essence of being human, I'd say.」

81:t_1:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Nice one, $n. So you're more than just a trash-picking fan.」

81:t_1:28.en:
$$マオ$$
「Closet perv, trash-picking fan, older-woman killer... You've got quite a few titles, $n.」

81:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Hold on, $$マオ$$. As for that older-woman killer thing...」

81:t_1:30.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't be shy, $n. Angels in white and lady teachers are every guy's romance, right?」

81:t_1:31.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クルツ$$...! Please don't make me and Nurse the targets of your hobbies without asking.」

81:t_1:32.en:
$$マオ$$
「Go easy on him, Miss $$スズネ$$. Looks like he's got some bittersweet memories of a lady teacher.」

81:t_1:34.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, well... I fish for it and get a hole-in-one. Now I've got a good way to kill time until we reach $$アメリア$$.」

81:t_1:35.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whoa! Is this about Big Bro $$クルツ$$'s first love!?」

81:t_1:36.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you like lady teachers that much, I'll introduce you to Miss $$美重子$$.」

81:t_1:38.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Though I don't think Mr. $$大門$$, the kendo master, will stay quiet about it.」

81:t_1:39.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Having a rival in love only fires me up! Right, $$カナメ$$?」

81:t_1:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why are you throwing that at me!?」

81:t_1:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...It's lively, isn't it, $$レド$$.」

81:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「I heard $c is part of a military organization. But it looks nothing like any military I know...」

81:t_1:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's no wonder you feel that way. From a regular army's point of view, we must be a rabble with no discipline at all.」

81:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we are human before we are soldiers. Outside the battlefield, we simply live freely.」

81:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「It may not ring a bell for someone to whom human meant soldier.」

81:t_1:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「I myself only came to truly feel it in the last year or so.」

81:t_1:50.en:
$$レド$$
「Will a day come when I can understand it too?」

81:t_1:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「But you have the aptitude. Because we thought so, we accepted you.」

81:t_1:54.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's do our best, $$レド$$. I'll work hard too, in what they call the Daily Life team.」

81:t_1:56.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But the road ahead's going to be rough. A decisive battle against the $$サイデリアル$$ awaits us on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

81:t_1:57.en:
$$勝平$$
「No need to worry, Big Bro $$クルツ$$. Whether it's the $$サイデリアル$$ or the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, if we combine our strength they're no match for us.」

81:t_1:60.en:
$$レド$$
「You don't understand how terrifying the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are.」

81:t_1:61.en:
$$勝平$$
「You say that, but we've been fighting enemies we can't even talk to, where it's kill or be killed too.」

81:t_1:62.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「About that... Couldn't the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ be $$バアル$$ too?」

81:t_1:64.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's a name for humanity's natural enemies we can't talk to. As $$ワッ太$$ says, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ for survival are likely 《$$バアル$$》 too.」

81:t_1:65.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#pilot$$s... Troublesome bastards are everywhere.」

81:t_1:66.en:
$$レド$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$...! Are they even out here in a remote corner of the galaxy!?」

81:t_1:67.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You know about the $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

81:t_1:68.en:
$$レド$$
「Yeah... They're an enemy of the Alliance, along with the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

81:t_1:69.en:
$n
「In $$ノリコ$$'s world, I heard the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest is at the center of the galaxy...」

81:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「So even in this world, their nest is there...」

81:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$バアル$$... The natural enemies of humankind that appear in huge numbers when the universe is reborn on a 12,000-year cycle...」

81:t_1:72.en:
$$マオ$$
「Looks like those things and the $$サイデリアル$$ are swarming around the center of the galaxy.」

81:t_1:73.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The universe is ridiculously big, and it's nothing but fighting...?」

81:t_1:74.en:
$n
「And within all that, the center of the galaxy seems to be a fierce battleground.」

81:t_1:75.en:
$$レド$$
($n is right, at the galactic center, various powers were fighting over supremacy and survival...)

81:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
(Thinking about it now, it's strange... Out of the whole wide universe, it seems the fighting was concentrated there...)

81:t_1:80.en: ～ $$レイクサイド・ダイナーズ$$ ～

81:t_1:82.en:
$$店長$$
「That's the fifth plate you've broken...」

81:t_1:83.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I lost to gravity again... 760 yen an hour for 6 hours... minus the 5 plates I broke today, that's a day's work for... um... 220 yen...」

81:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Curse you, Newton! I won't forgive you! $$ノノ$$ will pick up the fallen apples, so could you please make it so gravity never existed?」

81:t_1:85.en:
$$店長$$
「You ate the apples we sell... The apples cost 150 yen.」
